parse_benchmark_uri_from_string: parse a benchmark URI string into a BenchmarkUri object with scheme, dataset, path, params, and fragment
canonicalize_benchmark_uri: canonicalize a benchmark URI string by parsing and re-serializing it into normalized form
check_uri_startswith: check if a BenchmarkUri string representation starts with a given prefix
check_uri_endswith: check if a BenchmarkUri string representation ends with a given suffix
compare_benchmark_uris: compare two BenchmarkUri objects for equality or less-than ordering using string comparison
